name: tier-filter-stability
body: The four documented cargo invocations select the tiers they name: `cargo test` (the default gate) selects the unit and int tiers only and does not reach an e2e test; `cargo test-unit` selects only `tests::unit::`; `cargo test-int` selects only `tests::int::`; `cargo test-e2e` selects only the `#[ignore]`d `e2e::` tier. A unit or int test outside a `tests::unit::` / `tests::int::` path, or an e2e test reachable by a plain `cargo test`, is a violation.
